AppShellSkeleton.use: Render the frame's own parts as its loading state, with NavList.Skeleton in Sidebar.Content, inside a LoadingState; the v1-app-shell codemod rewrites it.

AppShellSkeletonProps.use: AppShellSkeleton is gone: the frame's own parts, with NavList.Skeleton, are its loading state.

LoadingBar.use: AppShell.Root's loading and loadingLabel props show page progress along the bottom edge of its header; Progress shows the progress of a task.

LoadingBarProps.use: AppShell.Root's loading and loadingLabel props show page progress along the bottom edge of its header; Progress shows the progress of a task.

useSidebarCompact.use: useSidebar().isRail says whether the sidebar shows icons only; AppShell.Root's sidebarOpen and onSidebarOpenChange keep its state.
